name: search-hole
description: Your own search gateway for Claude: choose the engines and sites it searches, see every search, get source receipts.
long_description: search-hole is a local, open-source search gateway. It searches through engines you choose (a private SearXNG, Tavily or Brave), applies your source rules (block, allow, pin, raise and lower sites), and gives Claude a receipt of what was searched, hidden and opened. The search log, your rules and your keys are stored on your computer; your blocked sites are sent to the engines as an exclude list. From the receipt card in the chat you can open the full receipt and block a site Claude used; Claude can only suggest rules, you approve them. Run `searchhole doctor` in a terminal, or open the dashboard with `searchhole ui --open`.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web through your engines and source rules, with dates, source types and a receipt.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Open a page safely (private addresses refused, your blocked sites respected) and read its text and dates.

tools.name: receipt
tools.description: Show what was searched, hidden and opened, as a card you can act on.

tools.name: suggest_rule
tools.description: Propose a source rule for you to approve; it never applies anything itself.

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API key (optional)
tavily_api_key.description: The easiest free engine: 1,000 credits a month, no credit card (a search costs one credit, a deep search two). Sign up at https://app.tavily.com and paste the key. Stored in your system keychain.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key (optional)
brave_api_key.description: Optional extra engine. Brave's API asks for a card; see https://brave.com/search/api/ for its current free credit and terms. Stored in your system keychain.
